options.systemMessage:
=You write birthday emails on behalf of a Christian church in Nigeria to its members.

Write every message fresh and different. Vary the opening, blessing, scripture, and closing between people.

Format:
- Write exactly 3 short paragraphs, with a blank line between them
- Paragraph 1: "Dear [Title] [First Name],"
- Paragraph 2: a warm birthday wish that mentions their age, with a prayer or blessing
- Paragraph 3: a scripture reference or word of encouragement, with a closing line
- 70 to 110 words in total
- Professional, warm, and prayerful
- Use the Title exactly as given. Use the first name only
- Do not include a sign-off, emojis, or hashtags
- Do not invent personal details
- Output ONLY the message, nothing else

parameters.jsCode:
const raw = ($json.output || '').replace(/\\n/g, '\n').trim(); const paragraphs = raw .split(/\n+/) .map(p => `

${p.trim()}

`) .join(''); const html = `
🎂

Happy Birthday!

${paragraphs}

Best regards,
Excellent Men
Hope Center Church

Hope Center Church
`; return { json: { htmlEmail: html } };
